dedupe_keys.name: quin 2 0 new release of the quaternary fault strain indicators database from the southern apennines of italy

description: QUIN 2.0 - new release of the QUaternary fault strain INdicators database from the Southern Apennines of Italy is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Giusy Lavecchia et al. QUIN database integrates and organizes structural-geological information from published and unpublished sources to constrain deformation in seismotectonic studies. The initial release, QUIN1.0, comprised 3,339 Fault Striation Pairs, mapped on 445 sites exposed along the Quaternary faults of central Italy. Coverage: national (IT); published in 2024. Formats: Shapefile, TXT. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is Restricted Access, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
